battleTraits.name: Further the Great Plan
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Battle Round, Start of Battle Round
battleTraits.declare:
You cannot use this ability in the first battle round. Pick an
**^^Asterism^^** that you have prophesied. You cannot pick an **^^Asterism^^** that you have previously picked this battle. If you do not meet the condition below that corresponds to that **^^Asterism^^**, this ability has no effect.
***Itzl the Tamer:*** 3 or more enemy units have been destroyed.
***Quetzl the Preserver:*** There are no enemy units wholly within friendly territory.
***Sotek the Deliverer:*** The enemy general is in combat or has been destroyed.
***Tepok the Seer:*** There are any friendly **^^Slann^^** units on the battlefield and no friendly **^^Slann^^** units are in combat or have been destroyed.
battleTraits.effect: Pick an **^^Asterism^^** ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied **^^Asterism^^** abilities.
battleTraits.effectPlain: Pick an Asterism ability to be prophesied. Its effects apply in addition to those of all other prophesied Asterism abilities.

battleTraits.name: The Great Plan
battleTraits.declare: You must use this ability. Pick an **^^Asterism^^** ability to be prophesied.
battleTraits.effect: That **^^Asterism^^** ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the 'Further the Great Plan' ability
battleTraits.effectPlain: That Asterism ability can be used for the rest of the battle, but the others cannot, unless prophesied by the 'Further the Great Plan' ability

If this unit used any **^^Fight^^** abilities this turn, place a **rage token** next to it, to a maximum of 3. If this unit did not use any **^^Fight^^** abilities this turn, remove all **rage tokens** it has.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Companion** weapons for each **rage token** it has until the end of the next turn.
abilities.effectPlain:
This unit must use this ability each turn.
If this unit used any Fight abilities this turn, place a rage token next to it, to a maximum of 3. If this unit did not use any Fight abilities this turn, remove all rage tokens it has.
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion weapons for each rage token it has until the end of the next turn.

abilities.name: Alpha Roar
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and each friendly **Aggradon Lancers** unit wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' **Companion** weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, place a **rage token** next to each target, to a maximum of 3 per unit.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets' Companion weapons for the rest of the turn. In addition, place a rage token next to each target, to a maximum of 3 per unit.

abilities.name: Nerve-shredding Screeches
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit within 10" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a D3. If the roll exceeds the target's Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.
abilities.effectPlain: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Skink Coordination
abilities.effect: If a friendly non-**^^Monster Skink^^** unit uses the 'Redeploy' command while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, no command points are spent.
abilities.effectPlain: If a friendly non-Monster Skink unit uses the 'Redeploy' command while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, no command points are spent.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stegadon's Horns and Jaws** is 4.
abilities.effectPlain: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Stegadon's Horns and Jaws is 4.

abilities.name: Crushing Stomps
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 2 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any, if this unit charged this turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Add 2 to the amount of mortal damage inflicted, if any, if this unit charged this turn.

abilities.name: Scry the Stars
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 3+, pick a friendly **^^Seraphon^^** unit wholly within 18" of this unit. That unit has **^^Ward (5+)^^** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a number of dice equal to the current battle round number. For each 3+, pick a friendly Seraphon unit wholly within 18" of this unit. That unit has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: Celestial Doom
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Blot Toad
abilities.declare: You receive 1 **Blot Toad** token for each **Ripperdactyl Chief** or **Ripperdactyl Riders** unit in your army, to a maximum of 3 tokens. Pick a number of enemy units equal to the number of **Blot Toads** you have to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Place a **Blot Toad** next to each target.
abilities.effectPlain: Place a Blot Toad next to each target.

abilities.name: Toad Rage
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's **Ripperdactyl's Tearing Jaws** while it is in combat with any units that have a Blot Toad.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Ripperdactyl's Tearing Jaws while it is in combat with any units that have a Blot Toad.

abilities.name: Ripperdactyl Assault
abilities.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Moonstone Warspears** used by friendly **Ripperdactyl Riders** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of Moonstone Warspears used by friendly Ripperdactyl Riders units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Fierce Guardians
abilities.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **^^Saurus^^** or **^^Kroxigor^^** units that target an enemy unit while that enemy unit is within 9" of this terrain feature.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Saurus or Kroxigor units that target an enemy unit while that enemy unit is within 9" of this terrain feature.

abilities.name: Power Unleashed
abilities.declare: If there are any friendly **^^Seraphon Wizards^^** within 3" of this terrain feature, pick another terrain feature within 24" of this terrain feature, then pick up to 3 enemy units within 3" of that terrain feature to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If that terrain feature has a Health characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.
abilities.effectPlain: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. If that terrain feature has a Health characteristic, inflict D3 mortal damage on it.

abilities.name: Deadly Cohesion
abilities.declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a friendly **Raptadon Chargers** unit that charged this turn and is within 12" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: This unit can use a **^^Shoot^^** ability as if it were your shooting phase. It must target a visible enemy unit in combat with the target.
abilities.effectPlain: This unit can use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase. It must target a visible enemy unit in combat with the target.

abilities.name: Arcane Vassal
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn, Any Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Skink Wizard^^** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Measure the range and visibility of the next **^^Spell^^** ability used by this unit this phase from the target instead of from this unit. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as 'Unbind' or 'The Earth Trembles'.
abilities.effectPlain: Measure the range and visibility of the next Spell ability used by this unit this phase from the target instead of from this unit. The target is treated as the caster for the purpose of other abilities or spell effects, such as 'Unbind' or 'The Earth Trembles'.

abilities.name: Supreme Master of Order
abilities.effect: Add 2 to casting rolls, and add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit can use an **^^Unbind^^** ability if an enemy **^^Wizard^^** anywhere on the battlefield uses a **^^Spell^^** ability instead of an enemy **^^Wizard^^** within 30" of this unit, and when using the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, this unit can pick a manifestation anywhere on the battlefield instead of within 30" of it.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 2 to casting rolls, and add 1 to unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit. In addition, this unit can use an Unbind ability if an enemy Wizard anywhere on the battlefield uses a Spell ability instead of an enemy Wizard within 30" of this unit, and when using the 'Banish Manifestation' ability, this unit can pick a manifestation anywhere on the battlefield instead of within 30" of it.

abilities.name: Dead for Innumerable Ages
abilities.effect: This unit must use this ability each turn while it is damaged. Roll 3D6 and add the number of damage points this unit has to the roll. On a 20+, this unit is destroyed. Otherwise, **Heal (18)** this unit.
abilities.effectPlain: This unit must use this ability each turn while it is damaged. Roll 3D6 and add the number of damage points this unit has to the roll. On a 20+, this unit is destroyed. Otherwise, Heal (18) this unit.

abilities.name: Celestial Deliverance
abilities.declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 18" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.
abilities.effectPlain: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

abilities.name: Selfless Protectors
abilities.effect: While any friendly **^^Slann^^** units are within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those **^^Slann^^** units have Ward (5+).
abilities.effectPlain: While any friendly Slann units are within this unit's combat range, both this unit and those Slann units have Ward (5+).

abilities.name: The Hunt Begins
abilities.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **^^Seraphon Cavalry^^** unit if those units have not been deployed.
abilities.effect: Set up that friendly **^^Cavalry^^** unit in reserve stalking the prey. Then, either set up this unit in reserve stalking the prey or set up this unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. Those units have now been deployed.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up that friendly Cavalry unit in reserve stalking the prey. Then, either set up this unit in reserve stalking the prey or set up this unit wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from enemy territory. Those units have now been deployed.

abilities.name: Saurian Ambush
abilities.declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve. Pick each friendly unit that is **stalking the prey** to be the targets.
abilities.effect: Set up the targets on the battlefield wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.effectPlain: Set up the targets on the battlefield wholly within 7" of the battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

abilities.name: Reptilian Instincts
abilities.effect:
This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve. Pick each friendly unit that is **stalking the prey** to be the targets. 
After that **^^Shoot^^** ability has been resolved, set up each target on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and within 18" of the unit that used the **^^Shoot^^** ability. 
Then, you can spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If you do:
• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
• Each target can move up to **X**", where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. It must end that move no further from the unit that used the **^^Shoot^^** ability than it was at the start of the move.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time a target uses a **^^Charge^^** ability, it must end that charge move in combat with the unit that used the **^^Shoot^^** ability
abilities.effectPlain:
This unit can use this ability even if it is in reserve. Pick each friendly unit that is stalking the prey to be the targets. 
After that Shoot ability has been resolved, set up each target on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units and within 18" of the unit that used the Shoot ability. 
Then, you can spend up to 3 rage dice. If you do:
• If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
• Each target can move up to X", where X is the number of rage dice spent. It must end that move no further from the unit that used the Shoot ability than it was at the start of the move.
Then, for the rest of the turn, each time a target uses a Charge ability, it must end that charge move in combat with the unit that used the Shoot ability

abilities.name: Cometary Alignment
abilities.effect: Pick a battle round. At the start of that battle round, set your and your opponent's **fury levels** to 7. Then, at the start of the battle round after the one you picked, set your and your opponent's **fury levels** to 1
abilities.effectPlain: Pick a battle round. At the start of that battle round, set your and your opponent's fury levels to 7. Then, at the start of the battle round after the one you picked, set your and your opponent's fury levels to 1

abilities.declare: Pick a friendly **^^Manifestation^^** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.
abilities.effect:
Spend up to 3 **rage dice**. If your opponent's **fury** level is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, add **X** to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons, where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent.
abilities.effectPlain:
Spend up to 3 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, for the rest of the turn, add X to the Damage characteristic of the target's melee weapons, where X is the number of rage dice spent.

abilities.name: Celestial Unmaking
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, other than the **Companion** weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's attacks have no effect.
abilities.effectPlain: Until the start of your next turn, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target's attacks have no effect.

abilities.name: Ordered Cohorts
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.
abilities.effectPlain: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while each model in this unit is contesting an objective you control.

abilities.name: Acid-fuelled Flame
abilities.effect:
Each time this unit uses a **^^Shoot^^** ability, you must pick either its **Glob of Flame Acid** or its **Stream of Fire** ranged weapon.
In addition, after resolving shooting attacks made with this unit's **Glob of Flame Acid**, if any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by those attacks, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.effectPlain:
Each time this unit uses a Shoot ability, you must pick either its Glob of Flame Acid or its Stream of Fire ranged weapon.
In addition, after resolving shooting attacks made with this unit's Glob of Flame Acid, if any damage points were allocated to an enemy unit by those attacks, subtract 1 from save rolls for that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.

abilities.name: Sun Acolytes
abilities.effect:
This unit has a crew of 3 **Sun Acolytes** that are tokens. 
Add 1 to this unit's control score for each **Sun Acolyte** it has. If this unit has no **Sun Acolytes**, it has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the battle.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Sun Acolytes** from the battlefield after the **^^Attack^^** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.effectPlain:
This unit has a crew of 3 Sun Acolytes that are tokens. 
Add 1 to this unit's control score for each Sun Acolyte it has. If this unit has no Sun Acolytes, it has a maximum control score of 1 for the rest of the battle.
Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its Sun Acolytes from the battlefield after the Attack ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).

abilities.name: Swift and Nimble
abilities.effect: When this unit uses the 'Redeploy' command, when determining the distance this unit can move, you can roll 2 dice instead of 1 and pick either result.
abilities.effectPlain: When this unit uses the 'Redeploy' command, when determining the distance this unit can move, you can roll 2 dice instead of 1 and pick either result.

ability.name: Being of the Stars
ability.effect: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).
ability.effectPlain: Ignore modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

ability.name: Reptilian Cunning
ability.effect: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'All-out Attack' command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.
ability.effectPlain: If this unit charged this turn, if a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'All-out Attack' command in the combat phase, no command points are spent.

ability.name: Beastmaster
ability.effect: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly **^^Seraphon Cavalry^^** and **^^Seraphon Monster^^** units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.
ability.effectPlain: Add 2" to the Move characteristic of friendly Seraphon Cavalry and Seraphon Monster units for the rest of the phase if they are wholly within 12" of this unit at the start of the move.

ability.name: Arcane Determination
ability.effect: Add 10 to this unit's control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly **^^Manifestation^^**.
ability.effectPlain: Add 10 to this unit's control score while it is wholly within 12" of a friendly Manifestation.

ability.name: Calm and Collected
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Your Turn
ability.effect: Reduce your and your opponent's **fury levels** by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players' **fury levels** by the same amount.
ability.effectPlain: Reduce your and your opponent's fury levels by up to 3, to a minimum of 0. You must reduce both players' fury levels by the same amount.

ability.name: Lord of Space and Time
ability.declare: Pick any number of friendly **^^Seraphon^^** units wholly within 12" of this unit that have not used a **^^Move^^** ability this turn to be the targets.
ability.effect: This unit gains a number of **stored time points** equal to the number of targets picked. Then, if this unit has 5 or more **stored time points**, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent's next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.
ability.effectPlain: This unit gains a number of stored time points equal to the number of targets picked. Then, if this unit has 5 or more stored time points, you can pick up to 3 visible enemy units within 18" of it. In your opponent's next turn, halve the Move characteristic of those enemy units. If you do so, this unit cannot use this ability again for the rest of the battle.

ability.name: Coatl Familiar
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a **^^Spell^^** ability for a friendly **^^Seraphon Wizard^^** within this unit's combat range
ability.effect: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.
ability.effectPlain: Add D6 to the casting roll for that spell.

ability.name: Bloodrage Pendant
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit's Health characteristic (rounding up).
ability.effectPlain: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons. Add 2 instead if the number of damage points allocated to this unit is equal to or greater than half of this unit's Health characteristic (rounding up).

ability.effect:
You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:

• If your opponent's **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, apply the effect below.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.
ability.effectPlain:
You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the target's Save characteristic, apply the effect below.
Subtract 1 from save rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Titanic Slam
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has **^^Strike‑last^^** for the rest of the turn.
ability.effectPlain: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if this unit charged this turn. On a 3+, the target has Strike‑last for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Chameleonic Camouflage
ability.effect: While this unit has not used a **^^Move^^** ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away
ability.effectPlain: While this unit has not used a Move ability in the same turn, it is not visible to enemy units more than 12" away
